_comment: Registry of every data source that may feed the corpus, the training pipeline, or evaluation. training.governance validates that each dataset referenced in produced JSONL is listed here, in scope, and not expired. Add a row BEFORE using a source.

sources.name: openFDA drug label API / DailyMed SPL
HAPI public FHIR R4 test server
sources.deid_method: synthetic data only; server must never hold real PHI
sources.notes: Shared public sandbox. Do not point FHIR_BASE_URL at a real endpoint.

sources.name: Specialty-society / national guideline PDFs (ACC/AHA, IDSA, ADA, KDIGO, GOLD, NICE, WHO)
sources.agreement_ref: PER-PUBLISHER — record each publisher's licence in this row before loading
sources.notes: Redistribution terms vary. Keeping the corpus local to one institution is normal.

sources.name: Systematic reviews / evidence reports (Cochrane, USPSTF, AHRQ)
sources.agreement_ref: PER-PUBLISHER — record each item's licence before loading
sources.notes: USPSTF/AHRQ are public domain; Cochrane is licensed.

sources.name: Institutional protocols / formulary / care pathways
sources.notes: Confirm no embedded patient examples before loading.

sources.name: MIMIC-IV (PhysioNet)
sources.deid_method: PhysioNet de-identification (dates shifted, ages>89 capped, identifiers removed)
sources.agreement_ref: FILL-IN: PhysioNet DUA + CITI cert id
sources.notes: Not usable until agreement_ref and expires are filled.

sources.name: Institutional EHR extract
sources.deid_method: FILL-IN: Safe Harbor OR Expert Determination (name + date + method)
sources.notes: Data must be de-identified BEFORE it reaches this repo. training.deident.verify() enforces record-level checks; it is not a substitute for a documented de-identification.
